root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

        fo.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        print(f"### {c['id']}  date={c['situation'].get('date')}  rc={p.returncode}")
